messages:
maya: Quick heads-up: Eos14B int8 bring-up failed nightly eval for summarization — abstractive summaries collapse into short repeats after ~900 tokens. anyone on call?
rachel: ugh, repro locally too. first pass looked like attention decay not logits scale. can you paste conversion flags?
maya: used our default: `redwood-quantize --model eos14b --dtype int8 --group 32 --perchannel --calib 1024`
maya: latency ok, but longer contexts degrade quality. short-context perf fine.
tom: could be rotary/freq mismatch. Eos was trained with per-head rotary scaling (nonuniform). our export flattened the `rotary_scales` to a single scalar in metadata.
rachel: do we have the original model's config? if it lists `rotary_scales` array then exporter bug for sure.
maya: grabbed config.json from upstream: "rotary_scales": [1.0,0.98,0.55,0.52,0.51,0.99,...]
tom: yep. our converted model metadata contains `rotary_scale: 0.9` (single). that would warp half the heads.
eval-bot: nightly-evals/eos14b-int8: summarization-rouge1: 0.42 -> 0.19 (regression), hallucination-rate: +18% (failing threshold).
maya: interestingly, int8 with group=1 (no grouping) keeps rotary array intact and summaries are fine. group=32 path is when exporter linearizes scales.
rachel: could be packing/transpose during kernel tiling that drops per-head attrs. any tokenizer oddities?
tom: tokenizer mismatch also present — upstream uses NFKD normalization and treats ZERO WIDTH JOINER as part of some ligature token; our tokenizer shim normalizes to NFKC and strips zwj. small shifts in token ids cause kv-offset mismatch and cause long-context reads to fetch wrong cache rows. combined with mis-scaled rotary -> cascading failure.
maya: repro log snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T04:11:09Z] eos14b.fp16: tokens=1024,rougeL=0.44,lat=92ms
[2026-03-20T04:11:09Z] eos14b.int8.group32: tokens=1024,rougeL=0.21,lat=58ms
```
rachel: root cause hypothesis: exporter + grouping optimizations drop per-head rotary metadata AND our tokenizer normalization diverges. both errors combine to shift attention geometry.
tom: short term mitigation: 1) re-run quant with `--preserve-rotary` (new flag) 2) add tokenization idempotence test for common ligature prefixes 3) run int8 with `--group 1` until exporter fixed.
maya: i tried `--preserve-rotary` and `--preserve-layout` together; int8/group32 perf still good and rouge recovers to 0.40 in quick smoke.
eval-bot: quick-smoke/eos14b-int8-preserve: rougeL=0.40,lat=60ms (passes smoke thresholds).
ops-bot: Scheduling canary: eos14b-int8-preserve -> dedicated-canary-2 at 2026-03-21T01:30:00Z.
maya: adding checklist entry: 1) verify `rotary_scales` length == num_attention_heads 2) tokenization roundtrip for known ligatures
rachel: i'll open a small PR to exporter to prefer explicit `rotary_scales` array over scalar fallback and add metadata assert. PR: #1044
tom: i'll add tokenizer unit that runs upstream tokenizer on base prefixes and asserts identical id sequences. also add a small diagnostic `inspect-rotary` that prints per-head effective angle.
maya: follow-up: let's also add a canary eval for longform summarization to catch regressions early. tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:
